passages.provision_quote: The department of education shall establish rules and procedures for establishing and maintaining a list of books that public educational institutions in this state are prohibited from using or making available to students
passages.note: Removal follows a state department of education review of a parent's submission, not a committee of educators and parents, so only the review-before-removal clause of the committee rung is met.
Aye on Senate third reading of SB 1700, which passed 16-12 so it is not near-unanimous; the vote shows her side but not a full rung.

rows.reasoning: Shamp voted Aye on SB 1700, whose operative section has a state department of education review parent-submitted books and add them to a prohibited list. That meets the clause that removal follows a review finding, but the reviewer is a state agency, not a review committee of educators and parents, so the rung is only partly evidenced.
needs_source: Shamp's own words on how school library book challenges should be handled
